hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript:
In this dimly lit inn, I was scrabbling the hearth, my fingers aching from the scrubbing. I heard a soft, muffled cry and peered around the corner. There, leaning on the table, was the new maid, her eyes wide with shock. I whispered, 'Are you alright?' She blushed, and I helped her to her feet, her simple dress a stark contrast to my own. We shared a secret moment, a promise to keep each other company."
